name: FLOWer
summary: FLOWer is a mobile freestyle rap battle game. Pick a beat, face other MCs online in real time, and spit your verses round by round, including back-and-forth rounds where you trade bars every few measures. Each battle is scored by a jury of other players, and wins push you up the ranking. You can practice solo on a library of beats, including drumless ones. Earn petals to unlock avatar frames and badges, join partner battle crews, and build your name in the Brazilian freestyle scene.
